articles.summary: Banco Santander, S.A. (SAN SM) and Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: Uber) today announced they have entered into an agreement to support Uber’s top fleet operators’ growth across Europe.The program has been tailored towards the financing needs of professional fleet operators. By facilitating access to flexible and agile funding, Uber and Santander seek to foster fleet investment and support Uber’s long-term growth strategy in Europe.
articles.title: Santander and Uber establish up to €1 billion financing platform to support European fleet growth
